notes: Taken from the Board of Elections' 46-day election notice, which lists every contest and issue with the precincts that vote on it, checked against the Board's precinct sample ballots. Issue wording is from the sample ballots and matches the notice.

Candidates are listed alphabetically by last name, not in ballot order: Ohio rotates the order of names from precinct to precinct. Certified write-in candidates are not printed on the ballot and are not listed.

"Where you live" uses the state voter file: a district or school levy is shown for a city, village or township when any of its voters live in that district. Your exact ballot depends on your precinct.
The Board's notice and sample ballots do not give local issue numbers.

Court of Appeals: Peter B. Abele (Republican) is still printed on the sample ballots for the 4th District seat; the Board's notice (revised October 15, 2026) says votes for him will not be counted due to his death and lists the replacement candidates certified October 5, 2026, Jayme Hartley Fountain (Republican) and Todd L. Grace (Democratic), as shown here.
